inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Records were evaluated for ten children enrolled and the following was determined:    Emergency contact information is needed for two children enrolled. A health statement is needed for eight children enrolled. The admission date is needed for four children enrolled. Current immunization records are needed for eight children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Two caregivers completed online pediatric CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection was completed 01/02/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Infant feeding instructions are needed for two children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Length: The transportation safety certificates did not specify the length of the training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Length (26 TAC §746.1329(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Additional Services Offered: The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation of transportation services.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Additional Services Offered (26 TAC §746.301(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The transportation binder was reviewed and it did not include  emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for the seven children the operation transports.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 2 years of age and within weight and height limit of child safety seat: During today's inspection a three year old child was transported without a child passenger safety seat. Note: The director added a booster seat in the vehicle during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 2 years of age and within weight and height limit of child safety seat (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(2))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass: The first aid kit in the van used to transport children did not have a working thermometer. Note: This was corrected during inspection when the director added a working thermometer to the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Thermometer, preferably non-glass (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Upon arrival I encountered two caregivers and one kitchen personnel. All were asked who was in charge in the directors absence and they stated the assistant director who was not present. The staff were asked who was in charge at that moment and there was no qualified caregiver designated to be in charge.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: The antiseptic wipes in the van used for transporting children expired 11/2020. Note: This was corrected during inspection when the director added antiseptic wipes that were not expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: An Emergency Preparedness Plan consistent with the requirements listed in minimum standards 746.5202 has not been added to the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The Emergency Preparedness Plan reviewed did not have procedures for relocating children who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The operation has not added the Emergency Preparedness Plan to the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregivers in the Discovery Preschool room was unaware of the number of children responsible for. A caregiver stated 15 children were in the room, however 16 were observed in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The Emergency Preparedness Plan did not include information about how the staff will continue to care for the children until each child has been released.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The Emergency Preparedness Plan was reviewed during inspection and the following is needed:    Instructions for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency.     The staff responsibility in a sheltering/lock-down emergency for the orderly movement of children to a designated location within the center where children should gather.     The alternate shelter away information provided to parents needed updating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The Emergency Preparedness Plan did not include How the operation will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: During today's inspection I observed a group of children napping in the Discovery Preschool class ranging from ages 14 months old-3 years old. The oldest child was more than 18 months older than the youngest child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation: The Emergency Preparedness Plan did not include information about how the operation will evacuate and relocate with information such as authorization for emergency care for each child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation (26 TAC §746.5202(3))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: During today's inspection I observed children laying on numbered nap cots in the Pre-K room. The number/child assignment chart posted was not followed. A number/child assignment list was not available in the Preschool room. Note: This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Updated immunization records is needed for three children enrolled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Three staff members need training in Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: During the follow up, there were still two screws missing on the climbing equipment in the DPS classroom causing the equipment to be unstable. There are still uneven cracks on the outdoor play area that also pose a tripping hazard for children who are playing on or near the surface.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Bottles in the Infant Room were missing a label.    Note: The provider labeled the bottles during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A dead bug was observed on the floor by a shelf in the classroom that has not been disposed of.    Note: The opreation disposed of the dead bug during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: 1 of the caregivers in the infant room stated there were 7 children in the classroom when there were 8 children accounted for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Two screws are missing on the climbing equipment in the DPS classroom causing the equipment to be unstable. A shelf is not secured to the metal plates posing a tipping hazard. There are uneven cracks on the outdoor play area that also pose a tripping hazard for children who are playing on or near the surface.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the DFPS Investigation, there is sufficient evidence to show the operation did not maintain adequate supervision of children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Documentation provided does not show the specific dates of when each training topic was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
